fullContentHtml:
SSC Delhi Police Head Constable Ministerial Final Answer Key / Marks 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Staff Selection Commission, SSC has released the final answer key for the post of Head Constable Ministerial on the official website of SSC. This recruitment was released for 456 posts. Applications for the Delhi Police Head Constable Ministerial Recruitment 2025 were accepted from September 29, 2025, to October 20, 2025. The CBT examination was held on 07-12 January 2026. Candidates who appeared for this examination can download their SSC Delhi Police Constable Ministerial Final Answer Key / Marks 2026 from the link given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 29 September 2025
  • Last Date : 20 October 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 October 2025
  • Online Correction Date : 05-07 November 2025
  • Exam Date : 07-12 January 2026
  • Self Slot Selection : 05 December 2025 to 05 January 2025
  • Exam City Details : 04 January 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam
  • Answer Key : 05 February 2026
  • Result : 05 June 2026
  • Final Answer Key / Marks : 22 June 2026

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 100/-
  • SC, ST : 0/-
  • All Category Female : 0/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Download Answer Key

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the answer key link.
  3. Select your exam date / shift / paper code.
  4. Download the answer key PDF.
  5. Calculate your expected marks and raise objections if any by the specified deadline.
